en.name: Vinaigrette, bottled
en.summary: A bottled vinaigrette is oil, vinegar and seasoning with no dairy, which makes it the more robust half of the salad-dressing aisle. Unopened it keeps about 6 months from purchase in the cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate and use within about 4 weeks. Freezing is not recommended.
en.pantry: An unopened bottle keeps about 6 months from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, away from the hob and out of sunlight. The clock here is the oil going stale rather than anything microbial, and warmth and light are what drive that. Store it upright so the cap does not weep, and give the bottle a shake before you first open it, since a bottled vinaigrette separates on the shelf as a matter of course.
en.fridge: After opening, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 4 weeks. Olive oil clouds and thickens in the cold; stand the bottle out for a few minutes and shake it, and it pours normally again. Wipe the neck after pouring, and never pour dressing back from a salad bowl into the bottle. Store it upright on an inside shelf rather than in the door.
en.freezer: Freezing bottled vinaigrette is not recommended and no freezer timeline is given for it. An oil-and-vinegar emulsion splits when it thaws, leaving oil floating above a layer of watery sediment, and shaking does not properly reunite them. Buy the bottle size you will use within a month, and pour the last of one over roasted vegetables or use it as a quick marinade.
spoilage: A rancid, crayon-like or paint-like smell from the oil
Separation that no longer comes back together after hard shaking
Mould around the neck or the cap
Cloudiness or sediment that was not there before, with a sour smell
tips: Shake hard before every pour; separation on standing is normal.
Write the opening date on the label.
Let a cold bottle stand a few minutes before use — olive oil thickens in the fridge.
Keep bottles out of sunlight; light stales the oil fastest.

faq.q: How long does bottled vinaigrette last once opened?
faq.a: About 4 weeks refrigerated at 4 °C or below.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle keep?
faq.a: About 6 months from purchase in a cool dry cupboard.
Freezing is not recommended and no timeline is given. The emulsion splits on thawing and will not shake back.

faq.q: Why has my vinaigrette gone cloudy in the fridge?
faq.a: Olive oil clouds and thickens when cold. Let the bottle stand at room temperature for a few minutes and shake it.

zh.name: 瓶裝油醋醬
zh.summary: 瓶裝油醋醬是油、醋加調味料，不含乳製品，是沙拉醬貨架上比較耐放的那一半。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 6 個月。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 4 週內用完。不建議冷凍。
zh.pantry: 未開封的瓶子放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬，從購買日起算大約 6 個月。這裡的時鐘是油走味，而不是微生物，而溫度和光正是加速它的原因。請直立擺放，避免瓶蓋滲液；第一次開瓶前先搖一搖，因為瓶裝油醋醬放在架上分層本來就是常態。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下，並在大約 4 週內用完。橄欖油遇冷會變濁變稠；把瓶子放著回溫幾分鐘再搖一搖，就能恢復正常倒出。倒完擦瓶口，沙拉碗裡的醬也絕對不要倒回瓶子。請直立放在冰箱內側層架，不要放門邊。
zh.freezer: 瓶裝油醋醬不建議冷凍，也沒有提供冷凍期限。油醋乳化在解凍時會分離，上層浮油、下層是含水的沉澱，搖也無法真正混回去。請買一個月內用得完的容量；剩下的就淋在烤蔬菜上，或拿來當快速醃料。
spoilage: 油發出油耗味、蠟筆味或油漆味
用力搖也不再混得回去的分層
出現原本沒有的混濁或沉澱，並帶酸敗味
tips: 每次倒之前用力搖；靜置分層是正常的。
冰過的瓶子先放幾分鐘再用——橄欖油在冰箱裡會變稠。
避免日曬；光讓油走味最快。

faq.q: 瓶裝油醋醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 4 週。

faq.q: 未開封的油醋醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 6 個月。
不建議，也沒有提供期限。解凍後乳化會分離，搖不回來。

faq.q: 油醋醬冰過變濁是壞了嗎？
faq.a: 不是。橄欖油遇冷會變濁變稠，放室溫幾分鐘再搖勻就好。
